physics.shapes: A (288,9) complex, B (288,3) complex; realified A_r (576,9), B_r (576,3)
physics.realification: sqrt(2)*[Re(J); Im(J)] via physics.realify_jacobian (unit-noise whitened); row order frequency->pose->illumination->receiver

declared_C.source: leading left singular vectors of realified full data tangent; declared candidate current directions, no oracle rank

settings.phase2_frames: 4 acquisition frames = the 4 frequencies of the full-wave model (shared map/pose parameters, per-frequency current)
settings.theorem7_metric: declared pose error metric M_x = I_3 (unit metric on the three pose coordinates); bias directions from residual left singular vector or random unit fallback
settings.claims_boundary: No physical-rank, envelope-nonidentifiability, nonlinear-basin, or method-superiority claim is made by this smoke runner.
